articles.title: DTCC plans to bring tokenized assets to Stellar in latest Wall Street blockchain push
articles.snippet: The U.S. market infrastructure giant targets connecting tokenized stocks, ETFs and Treasuries to Stellar in the first half of 2027.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Internet Computer (ICP) Jumps 9.8%
articles.snippet: Stellar (XLM), up 1.7%, joined Internet Computer (ICP) as a top performer.

articles.title: Singapore charges former Hodlnaut CEO Zhu Juntao over Terra collapse claims
articles.snippet: Zhu allegedly directed staff to publish false claims that Hodlnaut had no direct exposure to the TerraUSD collapse on Telegram and in customer emails.

articles.title: Prediction markets enter the derivatives era: XBIT DEX opens whitelist for prediction leverage, launching a 35,000 USDC campaign
articles.snippet: XBIT DEX takes the lead in introducing leverage to on-chain prediction markets, prioritizing the 2026 FIFA World Cup for its initial category. The whitelist application is now live.
